instruction: The system volume is currently too loud. Please reduce it to the minimum level (0%).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to set system volume to minimum (0%). Evaluator uses pactl command to check volume percentage, expecting '0\n' output. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter - no custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Verified that pactl command returns volume percentage as integer (0-100) followed by newline. Volume 0% produces output '0\n'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts system volume state using pactl command with proper parsing to get percentage value
Metric (exact_match) appropriately verifies exact 0% volume requirement
Expected value '0\n' correctly represents 0% volume output format
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting volume to 0%, evaluator checks exactly that
Command chain properly handles PulseAudio initialization and volume extraction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The command assumes standard pactl output format where field 5 contains the percentage - this is correct for standard PulseAudio but could potentially vary across versions
Minor: Multi-sink systems will only check the first sink (head -n 1), which is a reasonable interpretation of 'system volume' but could be clarified
